en.text: Laravel devs: stop copying your translations into JSON.
Most Inertia apps keep them twice: PHP for Laravel, JSON for the frontend. Then they drift apart.
Inertia Localize keeps Laravel as your single source of truth.
Your lang files ride along as an Inertia prop, and the React or Vue adapter gives you t().
en.speak: Your lang files ride along as an Inertia prop, and the React or Vue adapter gives you tee.

en.text: Call t() with a key. To switch language, call setLocale: the page re-renders in French.
en.speak: Call tee with a key. To switch language, call set locale: the page re-renders in French.

en.text: Install it with Composer and npm. Setup takes thirty seconds.
en.speak: Install it with Composer and N P M. Setup takes thirty seconds.

en.text: Inertia Localize is free and open source. Grab it from the link in bio!
